rationale: Independent inspection of the three attached primary-source page images confirms the selected differential-form identification and its inherited real, finite-dimensional, constant-coefficient context. The proof-free header, readable type, explicit type, and all 78 supplied dependencies preserve the field, matrix action, derivative directions, composed flux, and exact homogeneous balance.
